descriptions.w3d_worm_play_named_801359ec: Starts a named mesh animation when the worm animation guard permits it.
descriptions.w3d_worm_play_index_80135a70: Starts an indexed mesh animation when the worm animation guard permits it.
descriptions.w3d_worm_play_type_animation_80138d24: Looks up the worm-type animation name and starts it when the name is nonempty.
descriptions.w3d_worm_restore_animation_80139084: Stops an optional sound, restores the state-ten animation and clears elapsed time.
descriptions.w3d_worm_is_current_80139158: Tests whether the held worm equals the current actor referenced by the property.
descriptions.w3d_worm_release_effects_8013919c: Stops held effects, posts the effect identifier message and releases the graphic effect.
descriptions.w3d_worm_attach_resource_801397b0: Attaches a component mesh to the worm mesh and applies the stored resource value.
